i.norm: Verifies that matches() correctly computes [matchCount, halfTranspositions, commonPrefixLength] when comparing two CharBuffers of different lengths that share characters at non-overlapping positions. shorter (first arg): ['\0', '\0', '\0', 'f', '\0', '\0'] — length 6, 'f' at index 3 longer (second arg): ['\0', 'f', '\0', '\0', '\0', '\0', '\0', '\0'] — length 8, 'f' at index 1 All 6 shorter-string characters match something in the longer string (within the Jaro window), but the matched 'f' characters appear in reversed relative order → 2 half-transpositions. The first character '\0' is shared at position 0 → common prefix length = 1.
longer buffer: length 8, only index 1 holds 'f'
shorter buffer: length 6, only index 3 holds 'f'
matches() returns int[] { matchCount, halfTranspositions, commonPrefixLength }
